status: 300-item expanded bilingual beta practice pool for editorial and nursing review
disclaimer: Independent educational practice items. Not official NCLEX questions and not copied from any commercial QBank. Generated expansion items require RN/nursing educator review before public release.

items.stem: A client with a tracheostomy is making a high-pitched noise and appears anxious. What should the nurse do first?
items.stem_zh: 氣切病人發出高音調聲音並顯得焦慮。護理師應先做什麼？
items.rationale: A high-pitched noise with anxiety may indicate airway obstruction. Airway assessment is priority.
items.rationale_zh: 高音調聲音合併焦慮可能提示呼吸道阻塞，優先評估 airway。

items.stem: Which client should the nurse assess first on a medical unit?
items.stem_zh: 內科病房中護理師應先評估哪位病人？
options: A client with potassium 2.8 mEq/L and muscle cramps.
鉀 2.8 mEq/L 且肌肉抽筋的病人。
A client requesting a second pillow.
要求第二個枕頭的病人。
A client asking about visiting hours.
A client with dry skin requesting lotion.
皮膚乾燥要求乳液的病人。
items.rationale: Severe hypokalemia can cause dysrhythmias and requires prompt assessment.
items.rationale_zh: 嚴重低血鉀可造成心律不整，需要及時評估。

items.stem: A client with a head injury becomes increasingly drowsy and vomits. What is the priority?
items.stem_zh: 頭部外傷病人越來越嗜睡並嘔吐。優先處理是？
options: Assess neurological status and escalate care.
評估神經狀態並升級處理。
items.rationale: Worsening drowsiness and vomiting after head injury may indicate increased intracranial pressure.
items.rationale_zh: 頭傷後嗜睡加重和嘔吐可能提示顱內壓升高。

items.stem: Which postoperative finding requires immediate follow-up?
items.stem_zh: 術後哪個發現需要立即追蹤？
options: 尿量連續 2 小時每小時 15 mL。
items.rationale: Low urine output may indicate poor perfusion or fluid imbalance and requires prompt follow-up.
items.rationale_zh: 尿量低可能提示灌流不足或液體失衡，需要及時追蹤。

items.stem: Which task should the RN keep rather than delegate?
items.stem_zh: 哪項任務應由 RN 保留而不是委派？
options: Initial assessment of a newly admitted client.
新入院病人的初始評估。
items.rationale: Initial assessment requires RN judgment and should not be delegated.
items.rationale_zh: 初始評估需要 RN 判斷，不應委派。

items.stem: The RN delegates vital signs to UAP. Which instruction is best?
items.stem_zh: RN 委派 UAP 量生命徵象。哪項指示最好？
options: Report systolic blood pressure below 90 immediately.
收縮壓低於 90 立即回報。
items.rationale: Delegated tasks should include clear reporting parameters. Medication decisions, assessment and teaching remain RN functions.
items.rationale_zh: 委派任務應有明確回報標準；藥物決策、評估與教學屬 RN 職責。

items.stem: Which client is most appropriate for an experienced LPN/LVN under RN supervision?
items.stem_zh: 哪位病人最適合在 RN 監督下由有經驗 LPN/LVN 照護？
options: A stable client receiving routine oral medications.
穩定且需例行口服藥的病人。
A client with sudden respiratory distress.
A new admission requiring initial assessment.
需要初始評估的新入院病人。
A client requiring complex discharge teaching.
需要複雜出院教學的病人。
items.rationale: Stable, predictable care is more appropriate than unstable assessment or complex teaching.
items.rationale_zh: 穩定且可預期的照護較合適；不穩定評估和複雜教學不適合。

items.stem: Which statement by UAP requires RN follow-up?
items.stem_zh: UAP 哪句話需要 RN 追蹤？
options: I will report if the client becomes short of breath.
如果病人呼吸困難我會回報。
I will teach the client how to use the incentive spirometer.
我會教病人使用 incentive spirometer。
I will help the stable client bathe.
我會協助穩定病人洗澡。
I will record the intake amount.
items.rationale: Teaching requires RN responsibility and should not be performed by UAP.
items.rationale_zh: 教學屬 RN 職責，不應由 UAP 執行。

items.stem: A client taking spironolactone asks about diet. Which food should the nurse caution about?
items.stem_zh: 服用 spironolactone 的病人詢問飲食。護理師應提醒哪類食物？
options: 含維生素 C 食物。
items.rationale: Spironolactone is potassium-sparing; excessive potassium intake may increase hyperkalemia risk.
items.rationale_zh: Spironolactone 保鉀，過多鉀攝入可能增加高血鉀風險。

items.stem: Which finding should the nurse monitor for a client taking gentamicin?
items.stem_zh: 使用 gentamicin 的病人應監測哪項發現？
items.rationale: Aminoglycosides such as gentamicin can be associated with ototoxicity and nephrotoxicity.
items.rationale_zh: Gentamicin 等 aminoglycoside 可能與耳毒性和腎毒性相關。

items.stem: Which client statement about metformin requires follow-up before a contrast study?
items.stem_zh: 使用 metformin 的病人在造影檢查前哪句話需要追蹤？
options: I will bring my medication list.
I understand my provider may give special instructions.
我知道醫師/團隊可能有特別指示。
items.rationale: Metformin use around contrast studies may require provider instructions due to kidney/lactic acidosis concerns.
items.rationale_zh: Metformin 在造影檢查前後可能需特殊指示，涉及腎功能/乳酸酸中毒風險。

items.stem: A client taking lithium reports vomiting, diarrhea and tremor. What should the nurse suspect?
items.stem_zh: 服用 lithium 的病人回報嘔吐、腹瀉和顫抖。護理師應懷疑什麼？
options: Need for extra salt restriction only.
items.rationale: Gastrointestinal symptoms and tremor may indicate lithium toxicity and require prompt follow-up.
items.rationale_zh: 胃腸症狀與顫抖可能提示 lithium 中毒，需要及時追蹤。

items.stem: Which room assignment is best for a client requiring airborne precautions?
items.stem_zh: 需要空氣隔離的病人最適合哪種房間？
options: 可用時安排負壓單人房。
Shared room with any stable client.
與任何穩定病人共用房。
items.rationale: Airborne precautions commonly require a negative-pressure room according to facility protocol.
items.rationale_zh: 空氣隔離通常需按機構流程安排負壓房。

items.stem: A confused client pulls at IV tubing. Which action is best first?
items.stem_zh: 混亂病人拉扯 IV 管路。最先合適的行動是？
options: Assess causes and use least restrictive safety measures.
評估原因並使用限制最少的安全措施。
items.rationale: Safety care should assess causes and use least restrictive interventions before restraints unless immediate danger requires otherwise.
items.rationale_zh: 安全處理應先評估原因並採用限制最少措施，除非有立即危險。

items.stem: Which action is best when a client begins to have a seizure in bed?
items.stem_zh: 病人在床上開始抽搐時，哪項最合適？
options: Protect the client from injury and turn to side if possible.
保護病人免受傷並可行時側臥。
Put a spoon in the client's mouth.
items.rationale: Seizure safety focuses on injury prevention, airway support and not placing objects in the mouth.
items.rationale_zh: 癲癇安全重點是防傷、支持 airway，不把物品放入口中。

items.stem: Which action supports oxygen safety at home?
items.stem_zh: 哪項支持居家氧氣安全？
options: Keep oxygen away from open flames.
Smoke near oxygen if window is open.
窗戶打開即可在氧氣旁吸菸。
Use petroleum jelly near oxygen tubing.
在氧氣管附近使用凡士林。
items.rationale: Oxygen supports combustion; keep it away from flames and heat sources.
items.rationale_zh: 氧氣助燃，應遠離火源與熱源。

items.stem: A newborn is jittery and has poor feeding. Which assessment is priority?
items.stem_zh: 新生兒顫抖且餵食差。優先評估是？
items.rationale: Jitteriness and poor feeding may indicate hypoglycemia in a newborn.
items.rationale_zh: 新生兒顫抖和餵食差可能提示低血糖。

items.stem: Which postpartum finding should the nurse report promptly?
items.stem_zh: 產後哪個發現應及時回報？
options: Saturating a perineal pad in 15 minutes.
items.rationale: Rapid pad saturation suggests excessive bleeding and requires prompt action.
items.rationale_zh: 產墊快速浸透提示出血過多，需要及時處理。

items.stem: A laboring client has recurrent late decelerations. Which action is appropriate?
items.stem_zh: 產程中胎心反覆 late decelerations。哪項行動合適？
options: Reposition the client and notify the provider per protocol.
協助變換體位並按流程通知醫師/團隊。
不管開指情況鼓勵用力。
Ignore if the mother feels well.
若產婦感覺良好就忽略。
items.rationale: Late decelerations may indicate uteroplacental insufficiency and require intrauterine resuscitation actions and escalation.
items.rationale_zh: Late decelerations 可能提示子宮胎盤供血不足，需要相應處理和升級通報。

items.stem: Which instruction is important for a parent placing an infant to sleep?
items.stem_zh: 家長安置嬰兒睡眠時哪項指導重要？
options: Place the infant on the back to sleep.
Use loose blankets around the face.
items.rationale: Back-to-sleep positioning reduces sleep-related infant risk.
items.rationale_zh: 仰睡可降低嬰兒睡眠相關風險。

items.stem: A client says, 'I am angry that no one listens.' Which response is best?
items.stem_zh: 病人說：『我很生氣，沒有人聽我說。』最佳回應是？
options: I can see you are angry. Tell me what happened.
我看得出你很生氣，告訴我發生了什麼。
There is no reason to be angry.
items.rationale: The response acknowledges emotion and invites expression.
items.rationale_zh: 此回應承認情緒並邀請表達。

items.stem: Which response is best for a client expressing fear before a procedure?
items.stem_zh: 病人在操作前表達恐懼，哪個回應最佳？
options: Tell me what you understand about the procedure.
告訴我你對這個操作的理解。
items.rationale: Assessing understanding helps identify concerns and supports teaching.
items.rationale_zh: 評估理解有助於找出擔憂並支持教學。

items.stem: A client with panic reports feeling unable to breathe. Which action is best?
items.stem_zh: 恐慌病人表示覺得無法呼吸。哪項行動最佳？
options: Stay with the client and speak in a calm, simple manner.
陪伴病人並用平靜簡短語言說話。
Tell the client to stop overreacting.
告訴病人不要反應過度。
Leave the client alone to calm down.
items.rationale: Presence and calm simple communication support safety during panic.
items.rationale_zh: 陪伴與簡短平靜溝通有助於恐慌時的安全。

items.stem: A client refuses medication and says, 'You are trying to poison me.' Which response is most therapeutic?
items.stem_zh: 病人拒藥並說：『你們想毒害我。』哪個回應最具治療性？
options: I am not trying to poison you. Tell me what worries you about the medication.
我不是要毒害你。告訴我你對藥物擔心什麼。
Take it or you cannot eat.
items.rationale: The response does not argue with the belief and explores the client's concern.
items.rationale_zh: 此回應不與信念爭辯，並探索病人擔憂。

items.stem: Which cues suggest fluid volume overload? Select all that apply.
items.stem_zh: 哪些線索提示液體負荷過多？可多選。
items.rationale: Crackles, sudden weight gain and edema are consistent with fluid overload.
items.rationale_zh: 肺部 crackles、體重突然增加與水腫符合液體負荷過多。

items.stem: Which findings indicate possible hypoglycemia? Select all that apply.
items.stem_zh: 哪些發現提示可能低血糖？可多選。
options: Warm dry skin with fruity breath only.
只有皮膚溫暖乾燥且水果味呼吸。
items.rationale: Sweating, trembling and confusion are common hypoglycemia cues.
items.rationale_zh: 出汗、顫抖和混亂是常見低血糖線索。

items.stem: Which actions are appropriate for a client with suspected stroke symptoms? Select all that apply.
items.stem_zh: 疑似中風症狀病人，哪些行動合適？可多選。
options: Activate emergency/stroke protocol according to facility policy.
按機構政策啟動急救/中風流程。
items.rationale: Stroke care requires time awareness, focused assessment and rapid protocol activation.
items.rationale_zh: 中風照護需要掌握時間、重點評估並快速啟動流程。

items.stem: Which cues are concerning in a client with possible pulmonary embolism? Select all that apply.
items.stem_zh: 疑似肺栓塞病人哪些線索令人擔心？可多選。
items.rationale: Sudden dyspnea, pleuritic chest pain and low oxygen saturation are concerning respiratory/perfusion cues.
items.rationale_zh: 突發呼吸困難、呼吸性胸痛與低血氧提示呼吸/灌流風險。

items.stem: When an option says 'notify the provider,' what should the learner check first?
items.stem_zh: 選項寫 notify the provider 時，考生應先檢查什麼？
options: Whether nursing assessment or immediate safety action is needed first.
是否需先做護理評估或立即安全行動。
Whether it is the longest option.
Whether the family asked for it.
items.rationale: Notification may be correct, but the nurse often needs focused assessment or immediate safety intervention first.
items.rationale_zh: 通知可能正確，但護理師常需先做重點評估或立即安全處理。

items.stem: The phrase 'requires immediate intervention' most closely means:
items.stem_zh: requires immediate intervention 最接近的意思是：
options: Needs action now to prevent harm.
需要現在行動以防傷害。
永遠只是心理社會問題。
items.rationale: Immediate intervention means prompt action is needed for safety or clinical risk.
items.rationale_zh: Immediate intervention 表示因安全或臨床風險需要及時處理。

items.stem: Which phrase best explains a pain assessment?
items.stem_zh: 哪句話最能解釋疼痛評估？
options: I need you to pick a number because the form says so.
表格要求，所以你選數字。
Can you rate your pain from 0 to 10, where 0 is no pain and 10 is the worst pain?
請用 0 到 10 評分你的疼痛，0 是不痛，10 是最嚴重。
Pain is not important right now.
Your pain score should be low.
items.rationale: The phrase is clear, patient-centered and clinically useful.
items.rationale_zh: 此句清楚、以病人為中心且具臨床用途。

items.stem: Which phrase best shows escalation using objective data?
items.stem_zh: 哪句話最能用客觀資料做升級通報？
options: The blood pressure is 88/54 and the heart rate is 122.
items.rationale: Objective vital-sign data makes escalation clearer and safer.
items.rationale_zh: 客觀生命徵象讓升級通報更清楚且安全。

items.stem: Which approach is best after missing multiple pharmacology questions?
items.stem_zh: 連續錯多道藥理題後，哪種方法最好？
options: 建立按藥物類別整理的卡片。
items.rationale: Class-based medication cards help organize purpose, risks, monitoring and teaching.
items.rationale_zh: 按類別整理藥卡有助於組織用途、風險、監測與教學。

items.stem: Which behavior best supports timed-practice improvement?
items.stem_zh: 哪種行為最能支持限時練習進步？
options: Review why each wrong option was tempting.
複盤每個錯誤選項為何有誘惑性。
Skip all questions with long stems.
Translate every word in the final week.
最後一週逐字翻譯每個詞。
items.rationale: Understanding distractors improves reasoning and reduces repeat mistakes.
items.rationale_zh: 理解干擾選項能提升推理並減少重複錯誤。

items.stem: Which client with abdominal pain should be assessed first?
items.stem_zh: 腹痛病人中哪位應先評估？
options: A client with rigid abdomen and hypotension.
腹部僵硬且低血壓的病人。
A client with mild gas after eating beans.
A client asking for antacid refill.
要求補充制酸劑的病人。
A client with chronic constipation asking about fiber.
慢性便秘病人詢問纖維。
items.rationale: Rigid abdomen with hypotension suggests possible acute abdomen/perfusion concern.
items.rationale_zh: 腹部僵硬合併低血壓提示可能急腹症/灌流風險。

items.stem: Which discharge statement after heart failure teaching requires further teaching?
items.stem_zh: 心衰出院教學後哪句話表示需要進一步教學？
options: I will call if I gain weight suddenly.
如果體重突然增加我會聯絡。
I can stop my medication when swelling improves.
水腫改善後我可以停藥。
I will follow the sodium plan.
items.rationale: Stopping medication without provider guidance shows misunderstanding.
items.rationale_zh: 未經指示自行停藥表示理解錯誤。

items.stem: Which client with chest discomfort requires immediate assessment?
items.stem_zh: 胸部不適病人中哪位需要立即評估？
options: Chest pressure with sweating and nausea.
胸部壓迫感合併出汗和噁心。
Brief discomfort after spicy food now resolved.
辛辣食物後短暫不適現已緩解。
items.rationale: Chest pressure with diaphoresis and nausea may indicate acute coronary syndrome.
items.rationale_zh: 胸部壓迫感合併出汗和噁心可能提示急性冠脈綜合徵。

items.stem: Which finding in a client with diabetes requires immediate action?
items.stem_zh: 糖尿病病人哪個發現需要立即處理？
items.rationale: Symptomatic hypoglycemia requires immediate treatment.
items.rationale_zh: 有症狀低血糖需要立即處理。

items.stem: A client after hip replacement reports sudden shortness of breath and chest pain. What is priority?
items.stem_zh: 髖關節置換術後病人突發呼吸困難和胸痛。優先是？
options: Assess respiratory status and escalate care.
評估呼吸狀態並升級處理。
items.rationale: Postoperative sudden dyspnea and chest pain may suggest pulmonary embolism and require urgent assessment.
items.rationale_zh: 術後突發呼吸困難和胸痛可能提示肺栓塞，需要緊急評估。

items.stem: A client with a new arteriovenous fistula has no bruit or thrill. What should the nurse do?
items.stem_zh: 新建動靜脈瘻病人聽不到 bruit、摸不到 thrill。護理師應怎麼做？
options: Take blood pressure on that arm.
items.rationale: Absence of bruit/thrill may indicate fistula occlusion and requires prompt follow-up. Protect the fistula arm: do not use it for blood pressure, venepuncture or tight compression.
items.rationale_zh: bruit/thrill 消失可能提示瘻管阻塞，需要及時追蹤。保護瘻管側手臂：不要在該側量血壓、抽血/穿刺或施加緊壓。

items.stem: A client taking levothyroxine asks when to take it. Which instruction is best?
items.stem_zh: 服用 levothyroxine 的病人詢問何時服用。哪項指導最好？
options: Take it consistently in the morning before breakfast as prescribed.
按處方固定早晨早餐前服用。
與所有補充劑一起服用。
items.rationale: Levothyroxine is typically taken consistently before breakfast; consistency supports absorption and dosing.
items.rationale_zh: Levothyroxine 通常固定早餐前服用；固定方式有助於吸收與劑量穩定。

items.stem: Which finding suggests possible vancomycin infusion reaction?
items.stem_zh: 哪個發現提示可能 vancomycin 輸注反應？
items.rationale: Flushing and itching during vancomycin infusion may indicate infusion reaction and requires follow-up per protocol.
items.rationale_zh: Vancomycin 輸注中潮紅和瘙癢可能提示輸注反應，需按流程追蹤。

items.stem: Which action is best after a needlestick injury?
items.stem_zh: 針刺傷後哪項行動最佳？
options: Wash the area and report according to protocol immediately.
清洗部位並立即按流程報告。
Ignore it if there is no pain.
Wait until the end of the week.
Cover it and tell no one.
items.rationale: Needlestick injuries require immediate first aid and reporting according to exposure protocol.
items.rationale_zh: 針刺傷需要立即初步處理並按暴露流程報告。

items.stem: Which intervention helps prevent pressure injury?
items.stem_zh: 哪項干預有助於預防壓傷？
options: 定期為不能活動病人翻身。
items.rationale: Regular repositioning reduces prolonged pressure and pressure-injury risk.
items.rationale_zh: 定期翻身可減少長時間受壓與壓傷風險。

items.stem: Which newborn temperature requires nursing intervention?
items.stem_zh: 哪個新生兒體溫需要護理處理？
items.rationale: Low temperature with poor feeding may indicate newborn instability and requires intervention.
items.rationale_zh: 低體溫合併餵食差可能提示新生兒不穩定，需要處理。

items.stem: A parent asks when to seek help for an infant. Which statement indicates understanding?
items.stem_zh: 家長詢問何時需為嬰兒求助。哪句話表示理解？
options: I will seek help if the baby has difficulty breathing.
如果寶寶呼吸困難我會求助。
I will wait a week if the baby turns blue.
如果寶寶發紫我會等一週。
Fever in a young infant can always wait.
小嬰兒發燒永遠可以等。
items.rationale: Difficulty breathing is an urgent infant warning sign.
items.rationale_zh: 呼吸困難是嬰兒緊急警訊。

items.stem: The phrase 'no further action is needed' is safest only when:
items.stem_zh: no further action is needed 只有在什麼情況下才安全？
options: The finding is expected and no safety concern exists.
該發現可預期且無安全風險。
items.rationale: No further action is appropriate only when the finding is expected and safe.
items.rationale_zh: 只有當發現可預期且安全時，才適合不需進一步行動。

items.stem: Which review method is best for NGN case studies?
items.stem_zh: NGN case studies 最佳複習方法是？
options: Write the key cues and why they matter.
寫下關鍵線索及其重要性。
items.rationale: NGN improvement depends on cue recognition and reasoning, not answer memorization only.
items.rationale_zh: NGN 進步取決於線索辨識和推理，而不只是背答案。

items.stem: Which phrase best asks permission before assessment?
items.stem_zh: 評估前哪句話最能表達徵求同意？
options: I am going to check your wound now; is that okay?
我現在要檢查你的傷口，可以嗎？
I do not need to explain this.
I will do it quickly without telling you.
items.rationale: Permission and explanation support dignity, consent and OSCE communication.
items.rationale_zh: 徵求同意與解釋有助於尊嚴、同意與 OSCE 溝通。

items.stem: Which client statement about antibiotics requires further teaching?
items.stem_zh: 關於抗生素，病人哪句話表示需要進一步教學？
options: I will finish the course as prescribed.
I will report rash or breathing difficulty.
若出現皮疹或呼吸困難我會回報。
I can stop when I feel better after one day.
一天後感覺好轉即可停藥。
I will ask before taking other medications.
服用其他藥前我會詢問。
items.rationale: Stopping antibiotics early can contribute to treatment failure and resistance concerns.
items.rationale_zh: 過早停用抗生素可能導致治療失敗並增加耐藥風險。

items.stem: Which action best reflects clinical judgment in this mixed safety case?
items.stem_zh: 在這個混合安全情境中，哪項行動最能體現臨床判斷？
items.case: A client with asthma has wheezing and speaking in short phrases. The care plan also includes negative-pressure room as available.
items.case_zh: 一位哮喘病人出現喘鳴且只能短句說話。照護計劃也包含可用時負壓房。
options: Assess and act on wheezing and speaking in short phrases; apply negative-pressure room as available if relevant.
評估並處理喘鳴且只能短句說話；如相關則採取可用時負壓房。
Choose the longest option without reasoning.
items.rationale: Clinical judgment requires recognizing urgent cues, prioritizing safety and applying the relevant protocol-sensitive intervention.
items.rationale_zh: 臨床判斷需要辨識緊急線索、排序安全風險，並採取相關且符合流程的干預。

items.stem: Which phrase best demonstrates consent before wound assessment in an OSCE-style interaction?
items.stem_zh: 在 OSCE 式互動中，哪句話最能展現傷口評估前徵求同意？
options: You do not need to know why.
I will do this without explaining.
I need to check your wound now; is that okay?
我現在需要檢查你的傷口，可以嗎？
items.rationale: Permission and explanation support dignity and consent.
items.rationale_zh: 徵求同意與解釋有助尊嚴和同意。

items.stem: In an NCLEX-style stem, the phrase "priority action" most closely means:
items.stem_zh: 在 NCLEX 式題幹中，「priority action」最接近的意思是：
options: the safest and most urgent nursing action now
此刻最安全且最緊急的護理行動
the answer with the most medical jargon
the answer preferred by family members
a reason to stop reading the stem
items.rationale: The command phrase "priority action" directs what kind of answer the learner should select.
items.rationale_zh: 指令詞「priority action」會決定考生應選哪一類答案。

items.stem: The nurse is caring for a client with a tracheostomy with high-pitched noise and anxiety. What should the nurse do first?
items.stem_zh: 護理師照護一位氣切病人，出現高音調聲音與焦慮。護理師應先做什麼？
options: Document the finding and reassess at the end of the shift.
記錄該發現並在班末再評估。
Ask family members what they prefer.
items.rationale: A high-pitched sound can signal airway obstruction.
items.rationale_zh: 高音調聲音可能提示呼吸道阻塞。

items.stem: A client taking opioid analgesic needs nursing follow-up related to respiratory rate 8/min. Which action is most appropriate?
items.stem_zh: 使用 opioid analgesic 的病人因呼吸 8 次/分需要護理追蹤。哪項行動最合適？
options: Ignore the finding if the client feels well.
若病人感覺良好則忽略。
Give an extra dose without an order.
Assess sedation and respiratory status immediately.
立即評估鎮靜與呼吸狀態。
Teach that this is never clinically important.
教導這永遠不具臨床重要性。
items.rationale: Respiratory depression is a priority opioid safety concern.
items.rationale_zh: 呼吸抑制是 opioid 的優先安全風險。

items.stem: Which nursing action is most appropriate for seizure in bed when the issue is injury prevention and side positioning when possible?
items.stem_zh: 當問題是防傷並可行時側臥時，對於床上抽搐哪項護理行動最合適？
options: Protect from injury and support airway safety.
保護病人免受傷並支持 airway 安全。
items.rationale: Do not place objects in the mouth during a seizure.
items.rationale_zh: 抽搐時不要把物品放入口中。

items.stem: A postpartum client has boggy uterus and heavy lochia. What is the best nursing response?
items.stem_zh: 一位產後病人出現子宮鬆軟且惡露多。最佳護理反應是？
options: Assess the fundus and massage if atony is confirmed per protocol.
評估宮底，若確認 atony 則按流程按摩宮底。
Reassure that this is always expected.
安慰說這永遠是預期現象。
Wait until the next routine check.
items.rationale: Boggy uterus with heavy lochia suggests uterine atony and bleeding risk.
items.rationale_zh: 子宮鬆軟合併惡露多提示子宮收縮乏力與出血風險。

items.stem: A client says, "No one listens to me." Which response is most therapeutic?
items.stem_zh: 病人說：「沒有人聽我說。」哪個回應最具治療性？
options: I can see this is frustrating. Tell me what happened.
我看得出這讓你很沮喪，告訴我發生了什麼。
You should not feel that way.
items.rationale: Acknowledging feeling and inviting expression is therapeutic.
items.rationale_zh: 承認感受並邀請表達具有治療性。

items.stem: The RN is considering delegation of teaching a new insulin injection technique. Which decision is safest?
items.stem_zh: RN 正在考慮委派教新的胰島素注射技巧。哪個決定最安全？
options: 未提供回報標準直接委派。
Ask the family to decide scope.
Keep the teaching with the RN.
Assign based only on who is nearby.
items.rationale: Initial teaching requires RN responsibility.
items.rationale_zh: 初始教學屬 RN 職責。

items.stem: Which action best reflects clinical judgment in this mixed safety case?
items.stem_zh: 在這個混合安全情境中，哪項行動最能體現臨床判斷？

items.case_zh: 一位甲狀腺切除後病人出現口周麻與肌肉抽動。照護計劃也包含限制最少的防跌措施。

Assess and act on tingling around the mouth and muscle twitching; apply least restrictive fall-prevention measures if relevant.
評估並處理口周麻與肌肉抽動；如相關則採取限制最少的防跌措施。
items.rationale: Clinical judgment requires recognizing urgent cues, prioritizing safety and applying the relevant protocol-sensitive intervention.
items.rationale_zh: 臨床判斷需要辨識緊急線索、排序安全風險，並採取相關且符合流程的干預。

items.stem: Which phrase best demonstrates patient identification in an OSCE-style interaction?
items.stem_zh: 在 OSCE 式互動中，哪句話最能展現病人身份確認？
options: Can you tell me your full name and date of birth?
請告訴我你的全名和出生日期？
You do not need to know why.
I will do this without explaining.
items.rationale: Two identifiers support safety before care.
items.rationale_zh: 兩項身份識別有助照護前安全。

items.stem: In an NCLEX-style stem, the phrase "expected finding" most closely means:
items.stem_zh: 在 NCLEX 式題幹中，「expected finding」最接近的意思是：

a finding consistent with the condition or treatment

items.stem: The nurse is caring for a client receiving anticoagulation with sudden severe headache and confusion. What should the nurse do first?
items.stem_zh: 護理師照護一位接受抗凝治療的病人，出現突然嚴重頭痛與混亂。護理師應先做什麼？
options: Document the finding and reassess at the end of the shift.
記錄該發現並在班末再評估。
Assess for bleeding and notify the provider promptly.
評估出血並及時通知醫師/團隊。
Ask family members what they prefer.
items.rationale: Neurologic change during anticoagulation may indicate serious bleeding.
items.rationale_zh: 抗凝期間出現神經狀態變化可能提示嚴重出血。

items.stem: A client taking nitroglycerin needs nursing follow-up related to use with erectile dysfunction medication. Which action is most appropriate?
items.stem_zh: 使用 nitroglycerin 的病人因與勃起功能障礙藥合用需要護理追蹤。哪項行動最合適？
options: Ignore the finding if the client feels well.
若病人感覺良好則忽略。
Give an extra dose without an order.
Teach that this is never clinically important.
教導這永遠不具臨床重要性。
Teach that this combination can cause severe hypotension.
教導此組合可能造成嚴重低血壓。
items.rationale: Nitroglycerin and PDE-5 inhibitors can create dangerous hypotension.
items.rationale_zh: Nitroglycerin 與 PDE-5 inhibitor 可造成危險低血壓。

items.stem: Which nursing action is most appropriate for home oxygen when the issue is open flame nearby?
items.stem_zh: 當問題是附近有明火時，對於居家氧氣哪項護理行動最合適？
options: Keep oxygen away from flames and heat sources.
讓氧氣遠離火源與熱源。
items.rationale: Oxygen supports combustion and creates fire risk.
items.rationale_zh: 氧氣助燃並帶來火災風險。

items.stem: A newborn has jitteriness and poor feeding. What is the best nursing response?
items.stem_zh: 一位新生兒出現顫抖且餵食差。最佳護理反應是？
options: Reassure that this is always expected.
安慰說這永遠是預期現象。
Wait until the next routine check.
items.rationale: Jitteriness and poor feeding may indicate neonatal hypoglycemia.
items.rationale_zh: 顫抖和餵食差可能提示新生兒低血糖。

items.stem: A client says, "I feel ashamed that I need help." Which response is most therapeutic?

options: Many people need support during illness. What kind of help feels hardest to accept?
很多人在生病時需要支持。哪類幫助最讓你難接受？
You should not feel that way.
items.rationale: The response normalizes support and explores feelings.
items.rationale_zh: 此回應正常化支持並探索感受。

items.stem: The RN is considering delegation of care of a client with sudden respiratory distress. Which decision is safest?

items.rationale_zh: 不穩定呼吸狀態需要 RN 評估。

評估並處理出汗與噁心；如相關則採取防傷並可行時側臥。
Choose the longest option without reasoning.

items.rationale_zh: 臨床判斷需要辨識緊急線索、排序安全風險，並採取相關且符合流程的干預。

items.stem: Which phrase best demonstrates hand hygiene explanation in an OSCE-style interaction?
items.stem_zh: 在 OSCE 式互動中，哪句話最能展現手部衛生解釋？
options: You do not need to know why.
I clean my hands before care to reduce infection risk.
我在照護前清潔雙手，以降低感染風險。
I will do this without explaining.
items.rationale: The explanation links the action to patient safety.
items.rationale_zh: 此解釋將行動與病人安全連結。

items.stem: In an NCLEX-style stem, the phrase "requires follow-up" most closely means:
items.stem_zh: 在 NCLEX 式題幹中，「requires follow-up」最接近的意思是：
options: the answer with the most medical jargon
the answer preferred by family members
an abnormal or unsafe finding that needs further action
需要進一步行動的異常或不安全發現
a reason to stop reading the stem
items.rationale: The command phrase "requires follow-up" directs what kind of answer the learner should select.
items.rationale_zh: 指令詞「requires follow-up」會決定考生應選哪一類答案。

items.stem: The nurse is caring for a client receiving a blood transfusion with chills, fever and back pain. What should the nurse do first?
items.stem_zh: 護理師照護一位輸血中病人，出現寒顫、發燒與背痛。護理師應先做什麼？
options: Document the finding and reassess at the end of the shift.
記錄該發現並在班末再評估。
Ask family members what they prefer.
Stop the transfusion and follow reaction protocol.
停止輸血並按輸血反應流程處理。
items.rationale: These findings may indicate a transfusion reaction.
items.rationale_zh: 這些發現可能提示輸血反應。

items.stem: A client taking gentamicin needs nursing follow-up related to ringing in ears. Which action is most appropriate?
items.stem_zh: 使用 gentamicin 的病人因耳鳴需要護理追蹤。哪項行動最合適？
options: Ignore the finding if the client feels well.
若病人感覺良好則忽略。
Give an extra dose without an order.

items.rationale_zh: Aminoglycoside 可能與耳毒性相關。

items.stem: Which nursing action is most appropriate for enteral feeding when the issue is aspiration prevention?
items.stem_zh: 當問題是預防誤吸時，對於管灌哪項護理行動最合適？
options: Keep the head of bed elevated as prescribed.
items.rationale: Head elevation helps reduce aspiration risk.
items.rationale_zh: 抬高床頭有助降低誤吸風險。

items.stem_zh: 護理師照護一位疑似中風病人，出現新發臉歪與言語含糊。護理師應先做什麼？
options: Note time of onset and activate stroke protocol.
記錄發作時間並啟動中風流程。
Document the finding and reassess at the end of the shift.
記錄該發現並在班末再評估。
Ask family members what they prefer.
items.rationale: Stroke symptoms require rapid time-sensitive response.
items.rationale_zh: 中風症狀需要快速且有時間敏感性的處理。

教導這永遠不具臨床重要性。

清洗部位並立即按流程報告。

I will do this without explaining.
Can you rate your pain from 0 to 10?
請用 0 到 10 評分你的疼痛。

the answer preferred by family members
a reason to stop reading the stem
items.rationale: The command phrase "further teaching" directs what kind of answer the learner should select.

items.stem: The nurse is caring for a client with COPD with increasing work of breathing and restlessness. What should the nurse do first?
items.stem_zh: 護理師照護一位COPD 病人，出現呼吸做功增加且不安。護理師應先做什麼？
options: Document the finding and reassess at the end of the shift.
記錄該發現並在班末再評估。
Ask family members what they prefer.
items.rationale: Restlessness can be a cue of hypoxia or distress.
items.rationale_zh: 不安可能是低氧或窘迫的線索。

items.stem: A client taking opioid analgesic needs nursing follow-up related to respiratory rate 8/min. Which action is most appropriate?
items.stem_zh: 使用 opioid analgesic 的病人因呼吸 8 次/分需要護理追蹤。哪項行動最合適？
options: Ignore the finding if the client feels well.
若病人感覺良好則忽略。
Give an extra dose without an order.
Assess sedation and respiratory status immediately.
立即評估鎮靜與呼吸狀態。
Teach that this is never clinically important.
教導這永遠不具臨床重要性。
items.rationale: Respiratory depression is a priority opioid safety concern.
items.rationale_zh: 呼吸抑制是 opioid 的優先安全風險。

items.stem: Which nursing action is most appropriate for pressure injury prevention when the issue is immobility?
items.stem_zh: 當問題是不能活動時，對於壓傷預防哪項護理行動最合適？
options: Reposition regularly and protect skin integrity.
定期翻身並保護皮膚完整性。
items.rationale: Regular repositioning reduces prolonged pressure.
items.rationale_zh: 定期翻身可減少長時間受壓。

items.stem: A postpartum client has boggy uterus and heavy lochia. What is the best nursing response?
items.stem_zh: 一位產後病人出現子宮鬆軟且惡露多。最佳護理反應是？
options: Assess the fundus and massage if atony is confirmed per protocol.
評估宮底，若確認 atony 則按流程按摩宮底。
Reassure that this is always expected.
安慰說這永遠是預期現象。
Wait until the next routine check.
items.rationale: Boggy uterus with heavy lochia suggests uterine atony and bleeding risk.
items.rationale_zh: 子宮鬆軟合併惡露多提示子宮收縮乏力與出血風險。

items.stem: A client says, "No one listens to me." Which response is most therapeutic?
items.stem_zh: 病人說：「沒有人聽我說。」哪個回應最具治療性？
options: I can see this is frustrating. Tell me what happened.
我看得出這讓你很沮喪，告訴我發生了什麼。
You should not feel that way.
items.rationale: Acknowledging feeling and inviting expression is therapeutic.
items.rationale_zh: 承認感受並邀請表達具有治療性。

items.stem: The RN is considering delegation of teaching a new insulin injection technique. Which decision is safest?
items.stem_zh: RN 正在考慮委派教新的胰島素注射技巧。哪個決定最安全？
options: 未提供回報標準直接委派。
Ask the family to decide scope.
Keep the teaching with the RN.
Assign based only on who is nearby.

items.stem: Which action best reflects clinical judgment in this mixed safety case?
items.stem_zh: 在這個混合安全情境中，哪項行動最能體現臨床判斷？
items.case: A client with chronic kidney disease has palpitations and potassium 6.3 mEq/L. The care plan also includes exposure response.
items.case_zh: 一位慢性腎病病人出現心悸且鉀 6.3 mEq/L。照護計劃也包含暴露處理。

Assess and act on palpitations and potassium 6.3 mEq/L; apply exposure response if relevant.
評估並處理心悸且鉀 6.3 mEq/L；如相關則採取暴露處理。
items.rationale: Clinical judgment requires recognizing urgent cues, prioritizing safety and applying the relevant protocol-sensitive intervention.
items.rationale_zh: 臨床判斷需要辨識緊急線索、排序安全風險，並採取相關且符合流程的干預。

items.stem: Which phrase best demonstrates consent before wound assessment in an OSCE-style interaction?
items.stem_zh: 在 OSCE 式互動中，哪句話最能展現傷口評估前徵求同意？
options: I need to check your wound now; is that okay?
我現在需要檢查你的傷口，可以嗎？
You do not need to know why.
I will do this without explaining.
items.rationale: Permission and explanation support dignity and consent.
items.rationale_zh: 徵求同意與解釋有助尊嚴和同意。

items.stem: The nurse is caring for a client with asthma with wheezing and speaking in short phrases. What should the nurse do first?

記錄該發現並在班末再評估。

評估呼吸並按醫囑/流程給予急救治療。
Ask family members what they prefer.

items.rationale_zh: 只能短句說話與喘鳴提示呼吸窘迫。

options: Ignore the finding if the client feels well.

items.stem: Which nursing action is most appropriate for seizure in bed when the issue is injury prevention and side positioning when possible?

items.rationale: Do not place objects in the mouth during a seizure.
items.rationale_zh: 抽搐時不要把物品放入口中。

items.stem: A postpartum client has boggy uterus and heavy lochia. What is the best nursing response?

安慰說這永遠是預期現象。
Wait until the next routine check.
items.rationale: Boggy uterus with heavy lochia suggests uterine atony and bleeding risk.
items.rationale_zh: 子宮鬆軟合併惡露多提示子宮收縮乏力與出血風險。

items.stem: A client says, "No one listens to me." Which response is most therapeutic?

You should not feel that way.
items.rationale: Acknowledging feeling and inviting expression is therapeutic.
items.rationale_zh: 承認感受並邀請表達具有治療性。

items.stem: The RN is considering delegation of teaching a new insulin injection technique. Which decision is safest?

items.stem: Which action best reflects clinical judgment in this mixed safety case?

items.stem: Which phrase best demonstrates pain assessment in an OSCE-style interaction?

items.stem: The nurse is caring for a client with infection with new confusion, fever and blood pressure 86/52. What should the nurse do first?

options: Document the finding and reassess at the end of the shift.
記錄該發現並在班末再評估。
Assess perfusion and activate sepsis response per protocol.
評估灌流並按流程啟動敗血症處理。

items.rationale_zh: 感染合併低血壓和意識變化令人擔心敗血症。

items.rationale: Nitroglycerin and PDE-5 inhibitors can create dangerous hypotension.

items.stem: Which action best reflects clinical judgment in this mixed safety case?
items.stem_zh: 在這個混合安全情境中，哪項行動最能體現臨床判斷？
items.case: A client receiving a blood transfusion has chills, fever and back pain. The care plan also includes exposure response.
items.case_zh: 一位輸血中病人出現寒顫、發燒與背痛。照護計劃也包含暴露處理。
options: Choose the longest option without reasoning.
Assess and act on chills, fever and back pain; apply exposure response if relevant.
評估並處理寒顫、發燒與背痛；如相關則採取暴露處理。
items.rationale: Clinical judgment requires recognizing urgent cues, prioritizing safety and applying the relevant protocol-sensitive intervention.
items.rationale_zh: 臨床判斷需要辨識緊急線索、排序安全風險，並採取相關且符合流程的干預。

items.stem: Which phrase best demonstrates SBAR escalation in an OSCE-style interaction?
items.stem_zh: 在 OSCE 式互動中，哪句話最能展現SBAR 升級通報？
options: The blood pressure is 88/54 and heart rate is 122.
You do not need to know why.
I will do this without explaining.
items.rationale: Objective data makes escalation clearer.
items.rationale_zh: 客觀資料讓升級通報更清楚。

items.stem: In an NCLEX-style stem, the phrase "best response" most closely means:

the response that is safest and most therapeutic in context
該情境中最安全且最具治療性的回應
the answer preferred by family members
a reason to stop reading the stem
items.rationale: The command phrase "best response" directs what kind of answer the learner should select.
items.rationale_zh: 指令詞「best response」會決定考生應選哪一類答案。

items.stem: The nurse is caring for a client with vomiting and diarrhea with dizziness and poor skin turgor. What should the nurse do first?
items.stem_zh: 護理師照護一位嘔吐腹瀉病人，出現頭暈且皮膚彈性差。護理師應先做什麼？
options: Document the finding and reassess at the end of the shift.
記錄該發現並在班末再評估。
Assess hydration status and vital signs.
評估水合狀態與生命徵象。
Ask family members what they prefer.
items.rationale: Fluid loss can cause dehydration and perfusion problems.
items.rationale_zh: 體液流失可造成脫水和灌流問題。

items.stem: A client taking nitroglycerin needs nursing follow-up related to use with erectile dysfunction medication. Which action is most appropriate?

options: Ignore the finding if the client feels well.

Give an extra dose without an order.
Teach that this is never clinically important.
教導這永遠不具臨床重要性。
Teach that this combination can cause severe hypotension.
教導此組合可能造成嚴重低血壓。
items.rationale: Nitroglycerin and PDE-5 inhibitors can create dangerous hypotension.
items.rationale_zh: Nitroglycerin 與 PDE-5 inhibitor 可造成危險低血壓。

items.stem: Which nursing action is most appropriate for C. difficile infection when the issue is contact precautions and soap-and-water hand hygiene?

options: Use contact precautions and soap-and-water hand hygiene.
使用接觸隔離並用肥皂水洗手。
items.rationale: C. difficile spores are not reliably removed by alcohol rub alone.
items.rationale_zh: C. difficile 孢子不能可靠地只靠酒精乾洗手去除。

items.stem: A newborn has jitteriness and poor feeding. What is the best nursing response?

安慰說這永遠是預期現象。
Wait until the next routine check.
items.rationale: Jitteriness and poor feeding may indicate neonatal hypoglycemia.
items.rationale_zh: 顫抖和餵食差可能提示新生兒低血糖。

items.stem: A client says, "I feel ashamed that I need help." Which response is most therapeutic?

items.rationale: The response normalizes support and explores feelings.
items.rationale_zh: 此回應正常化支持並探索感受。

items.rationale: New dyspnea with low oxygen saturation is an immediate breathing concern.
items.rationale_zh: 新發呼吸困難合併低血氧是立即的 breathing 風險。

items.stem: A newborn has jitteriness and poor feeding. What is the best nursing response?

options: Reassure that this is always expected.
安慰說這永遠是預期現象。
Wait until the next routine check.
items.rationale: Jitteriness and poor feeding may indicate neonatal hypoglycemia.
items.rationale_zh: 顫抖和餵食差可能提示新生兒低血糖。

items.stem: A client says, "I feel ashamed that I need help." Which response is most therapeutic?

items.rationale: The response normalizes support and explores feelings.
items.rationale_zh: 此回應正常化支持並探索感受。

items.stem: The RN is considering delegation of care of a client with sudden respiratory distress. Which decision is safest?
items.stem_zh: RN 正在考慮委派突然呼吸窘迫病人的照護。哪個決定最安全？
options: 未提供回報標準直接委派。
Ask the family to decide scope.
Assign based only on who is nearby.
Assign to an RN for immediate assessment.
分配給 RN 立即評估。
items.rationale: Unstable respiratory status requires RN assessment.
items.rationale_zh: 不穩定呼吸狀態需要 RN 評估。

items.stem: Which action best reflects clinical judgment in this mixed safety case?
items.stem_zh: 在這個混合安全情境中，哪項行動最能體現臨床判斷？
items.case: A client with head injury has increasing drowsiness and vomiting. The care plan also includes immobility.
items.case_zh: 一位頭部外傷病人出現嗜睡加重與嘔吐。照護計劃也包含不能活動。
options: Assess and act on increasing drowsiness and vomiting; apply immobility if relevant.
評估並處理嗜睡加重與嘔吐；如相關則採取不能活動。

items.rationale: Clinical judgment requires recognizing urgent cues, prioritizing safety and applying the relevant protocol-sensitive intervention.
items.rationale_zh: 臨床判斷需要辨識緊急線索、排序安全風險，並採取相關且符合流程的干預。

items.stem: Which phrase best demonstrates hand hygiene explanation in an OSCE-style interaction?

items.stem: In an NCLEX-style stem, the phrase "requires follow-up" most closely means:

items.stem: The nurse is caring for a client after thyroidectomy with tingling around the mouth and muscle twitching. What should the nurse do first?

items.rationale_zh: 甲狀腺術後口周麻和抽動可能提示低血鈣。

items.stem: A client taking gentamicin needs nursing follow-up related to ringing in ears. Which action is most appropriate?

items.stem: Which nursing action is most appropriate for airborne infection concern when the issue is negative-pressure room as available?

items.stem: Which action best reflects clinical judgment in this mixed safety case?
items.stem_zh: 在這個混合安全情境中，哪項行動最能體現臨床判斷？
items.case: A postoperative client has new shortness of breath and oxygen saturation 88%. The care plan also includes injury prevention and side positioning when possible.
items.case_zh: 一位術後病人出現新發呼吸困難且血氧 88%。照護計劃也包含防傷並可行時側臥。
options: Assess and act on new shortness of breath and oxygen saturation 88%; apply injury prevention and side positioning when possible if relevant.
評估並處理新發呼吸困難且血氧 88%；如相關則採取防傷並可行時側臥。
Choose the longest option without reasoning.
items.rationale: Clinical judgment requires recognizing urgent cues, prioritizing safety and applying the relevant protocol-sensitive intervention.
items.rationale_zh: 臨床判斷需要辨識緊急線索、排序安全風險，並採取相關且符合流程的干預。

items.stem: Which phrase best demonstrates patient identification in an OSCE-style interaction?
items.stem_zh: 在 OSCE 式互動中，哪句話最能展現病人身份確認？
options: You do not need to know why.
Can you tell me your full name and date of birth?
請告訴我你的全名和出生日期？
I will do this without explaining.
items.rationale: Two identifiers support safety before care.
items.rationale_zh: 兩項身份識別有助照護前安全。

items.stem: In an NCLEX-style stem, the phrase "expected finding" most closely means:
items.stem_zh: 在 NCLEX 式題幹中，「expected finding」最接近的意思是：
options: the answer with the most medical jargon
the answer preferred by family members
a finding consistent with the condition or treatment
與情況或治療相符的發現
a reason to stop reading the stem
items.rationale: The command phrase "expected finding" directs what kind of answer the learner should select.
items.rationale_zh: 指令詞「expected finding」會決定考生應選哪一類答案。

items.stem: The nurse is caring for a client with chronic kidney disease with palpitations and potassium 6.3 mEq/L. What should the nurse do first?
items.stem_zh: 護理師照護一位慢性腎病病人，出現心悸且鉀 6.3 mEq/L。護理師應先做什麼？
options: Document the finding and reassess at the end of the shift.
記錄該發現並在班末再評估。
Ask family members what they prefer.
Place the client on cardiac monitoring and escalate care.
進行心電監測並升級處理。
items.rationale: Hyperkalemia can cause life-threatening dysrhythmias.
items.rationale_zh: 高血鉀可造成危及生命的心律不整。

items.stem: A client taking gentamicin needs nursing follow-up related to ringing in ears. Which action is most appropriate?
items.stem_zh: 使用 gentamicin 的病人因耳鳴需要護理追蹤。哪項行動最合適？
options: Ignore the finding if the client feels well.
若病人感覺良好則忽略。
Give an extra dose without an order.
Teach that this is never clinically important.
教導這永遠不具臨床重要性。
items.rationale: Aminoglycosides may be associated with ototoxicity.
items.rationale_zh: Aminoglycoside 可能與耳毒性相關。

items.stem: Which nursing action is most appropriate for enteral feeding when the issue is aspiration prevention?
items.stem_zh: 當問題是預防誤吸時，對於管灌哪項護理行動最合適？
options: Keep the head of bed elevated as prescribed.
items.rationale: Head elevation helps reduce aspiration risk.
items.rationale_zh: 抬高床頭有助降低誤吸風險。

items.stem: A postpartum client has boggy uterus and heavy lochia. What is the best nursing response?
items.stem_zh: 一位產後病人出現子宮鬆軟且惡露多。最佳護理反應是？
options: Reassure that this is always expected.
安慰說這永遠是預期現象。
Wait until the next routine check.
Assess the fundus and massage if atony is confirmed per protocol.
評估宮底，若確認 atony 則按流程按摩宮底。
items.rationale: Boggy uterus with heavy lochia suggests uterine atony and bleeding risk.
items.rationale_zh: 子宮鬆軟合併惡露多提示子宮收縮乏力與出血風險。

items.stem: A client says, "No one listens to me." Which response is most therapeutic?
items.stem_zh: 病人說：「沒有人聽我說。」哪個回應最具治療性？
options: You should not feel that way.
I can see this is frustrating. Tell me what happened.
我看得出這讓你很沮喪，告訴我發生了什麼。
items.rationale: Acknowledging feeling and inviting expression is therapeutic.
items.rationale_zh: 承認感受並邀請表達具有治療性。

items.stem: The RN is considering delegation of teaching a new insulin injection technique. Which decision is safest?
items.stem_zh: RN 正在考慮委派教新的胰島素注射技巧。哪個決定最安全？
options: Keep the teaching with the RN.
未提供回報標準直接委派。
Ask the family to decide scope.
Assign based only on who is nearby.
items.rationale: Initial teaching requires RN responsibility.
items.rationale_zh: 初始教學屬 RN 職責。

items.stem: Which action best reflects clinical judgment in this mixed safety case?
items.stem_zh: 在這個混合安全情境中，哪項行動最能體現臨床判斷？
items.case: A client with a tracheostomy has high-pitched noise and anxiety. The care plan also includes open flame nearby.
items.case_zh: 一位氣切病人出現高音調聲音與焦慮。照護計劃也包含附近有明火。
options: Assess and act on high-pitched noise and anxiety; apply open flame nearby if relevant.
評估並處理高音調聲音與焦慮；如相關則採取附近有明火。
Choose the longest option without reasoning.
items.rationale: Clinical judgment requires recognizing urgent cues, prioritizing safety and applying the relevant protocol-sensitive intervention.
items.rationale_zh: 臨床判斷需要辨識緊急線索、排序安全風險，並採取相關且符合流程的干預。

items.stem: Which phrase best demonstrates hand hygiene explanation in an OSCE-style interaction?
items.stem_zh: 在 OSCE 式互動中，哪句話最能展現手部衛生解釋？
options: You do not need to know why.
I will do this without explaining.
I clean my hands before care to reduce infection risk.
我在照護前清潔雙手，以降低感染風險。
items.rationale: The explanation links the action to patient safety.
items.rationale_zh: 此解釋將行動與病人安全連結。

items.stem: In an NCLEX-style stem, the phrase "requires follow-up" most closely means:
items.stem_zh: 在 NCLEX 式題幹中，「requires follow-up」最接近的意思是：
options: the answer with the most medical jargon
the answer preferred by family members
a reason to stop reading the stem
an abnormal or unsafe finding that needs further action
需要進一步行動的異常或不安全發現
items.rationale: The command phrase "requires follow-up" directs what kind of answer the learner should select.
items.rationale_zh: 指令詞「requires follow-up」會決定考生應選哪一類答案。

items.stem: The nurse is caring for a client with head injury with increasing drowsiness and vomiting. What should the nurse do first?
items.stem_zh: 護理師照護一位頭部外傷病人，出現嗜睡加重與嘔吐。護理師應先做什麼？
options: Assess neurologic status and escalate care.
評估神經狀態並升級處理。
Document the finding and reassess at the end of the shift.
記錄該發現並在班末再評估。
Ask family members what they prefer.
items.rationale: Worsening neurologic cues after head injury may indicate increased intracranial pressure.
items.rationale_zh: 頭傷後神經線索惡化可能提示顱內壓升高。

items.stem: A client taking warfarin needs nursing follow-up related to black stools. Which action is most appropriate?
items.stem_zh: 使用 warfarin 的病人因黑便需要護理追蹤。哪項行動最合適？
options: Ignore the finding if the client feels well.
若病人感覺良好則忽略。
Assess for bleeding and review anticoagulation instructions.
評估出血並複核抗凝相關指示。
Give an extra dose without an order.
Teach that this is never clinically important.
教導這永遠不具臨床重要性。
items.rationale: Black stools may indicate gastrointestinal bleeding.
items.rationale_zh: 黑便可能提示胃腸道出血。

items.stem: Which nursing action is most appropriate for needlestick injury when the issue is exposure response?
items.stem_zh: 當問題是暴露處理時，對於針刺傷哪項護理行動最合適？
options: Wash the area and report immediately according to protocol.
清洗部位並立即按流程報告。
items.rationale: Occupational exposure requires prompt reporting and protocol-based follow-up.
items.rationale_zh: 職業暴露需要及時報告與按流程追蹤。

items.stem: A newborn has jitteriness and poor feeding. What is the best nursing response?
items.stem_zh: 一位新生兒出現顫抖且餵食差。最佳護理反應是？
options: Reassure that this is always expected.
安慰說這永遠是預期現象。
Wait until the next routine check.
items.rationale: Jitteriness and poor feeding may indicate neonatal hypoglycemia.
items.rationale_zh: 顫抖和餵食差可能提示新生兒低血糖。
